guardrails: Do not optimise on impressions alone

months.objective: Validate the core problem and proposition.

weeks.theme: Recognise the gap between balance and what remains
weeks.hypothesis: The bank-balance framing will create the strongest qualified response.
Manual control will reduce privacy objections without depressing CTA interest.
A short formula will produce more landing visits than abstract benefit copy.

weeks.theme: Apply all three messages to real-life costs
weeks.hypothesis: One-off cost scenarios will reveal which proposition remains persuasive in context.

months.decisionRule: Select the message with the strongest preview-start rate after checking landing CTA rate and sufficient directional volume; retain inconclusive variants for further testing.

months.objective: Validate audiences, objections and use cases using the winning Month 1 message.

weeks.hypothesis: Due-date tension will resonate with people whose bills cluster late in the pay cycle.
User-controlled figures will answer the bank-connection objection.
An irregular-cost scenario will increase product comprehension.
Acknowledging valid alternatives will improve CTA quality and trust.

months.decisionRule: Choose the audience/use-case combination with the best qualified landing-to-preview progression, not the largest reach.

months.objective: Validate format, CTA and conversion using the winning message and audience.

weeks.theme: Static formula graphic versus founder text
weeks.hypothesis: The visible calculation will improve link-click intent.
Stepwise explanation will improve landing CTA clicks.
Check my position free will outperform a generic try-free CTA.
Repeating the selected message, audience, format and CTA will confirm whether the result is stable.

months.decisionRule: Adopt only a result that repeats directionally across at least two posts; otherwise document the test as inconclusive.

messageVariants.a: Your bank balance is not necessarily what you can spend.
messageVariants.b: Know what remains without connecting your bank.
messageVariants.c: Balance minus what is still due before payday.
